## Research change summary

What changed and why? State whether this is an editorial correction, code quality improvement, new observation, or new hypothesis.

## Scientific claim and falsification

- **Precise testable claim:** 
- **Status:** `EDITORIAL / EXPLORATORY / CALIBRATION / POSITIVE_LIMITED / NEGATIVE_LIMITED / INCONCLUSIVE / NOT_EVALUABLE`
- **What result would falsify the claim?** 
- **What does this change NOT establish?**

## Source, methods and reproducibility

- [ ] Source and rights information (input URL, immutable version, SHA-256, attribution) is documented where relevant.
- [ ] Training, validation and test separation are explicit; prior exposure of folios is disclosed.
- [ ] Competing baselines and null controls are appropriate for the exact claim.
- [ ] Synthetic tests and applicable real-source CI completed; links to actual runs and outcomes are included.
- [ ] Negative outcomes, uncertainties and failed runs are not removed.
- [ ] Any historical word/sound/meaning claim remains `NOT ESTIMABLE` unless external evidence is independently verified.

## Publication safety

- [ ] English documentation and meaningful error messages.
- [ ] No private Sherlock source, model weights, candidate keys or private research records.
- [ ] No API keys, credentials, personal data, or unauthorized third-party text and image assets.
- [ ] No unapproved license or copyright change.
- [ ] Public [research quality audit](scripts/audit_public_repo.py) and affected tests pass, or failures are explained.

## Reviewer notes

Explain any deviation from frozen protocols, any new testing on previously explored data, and what **independent** scientific review remains outstanding. A merged PR alone does not validate a historical decipherment.
